chipset-rk3399: Enable H264 Hardware Video Encoder on ARC. According to Rk3399 TRM, the feature of H264 encoder: - Supported image size: 96x96 to 1920x1080 - Maximum frame rate: 30 fps at 1920x1080 - Bit rate: 10kbps to 20Mbps So block-per-second is (1920/16) * (1088/16) * 30 = 244800 BUG=b:71882314 TEST=Record video and check OMX.arc.h264.encoder is used CQ-DEPEND=CL:940722,CL:939226 Change-Id: I95ceb99e5d04f5a517dc35771c73f579d4c6727f Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/896666 Commit-Ready: Chih-Yu Huang <akahuang@chromium.org> Tested-by: Chih-Yu Huang <akahuang@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Pawel Osciak <posciak@chromium.org>

cros tryjob: Add --json option. Add a new option "--json" to output information about scheduled jobs in json format. This is intended to make it easier for scripts that invoke tryjobs to parse the results. If "cros tryjob" fails for any reason, the output will NOT be json. Sample json: cros tryjob --yes --swarming success-build fail-build [ { "build_config": "success-build", "buildbucket_id": "8952660457862247296", "url": "<long_url_shortened>" }, { "build_config": "fail-build", "buildbucket_id": "8952660457215487216", "url": "<long_url_shortened>" } ] BUG=chromium:807029 TEST=Manual tryjobs + run_tests Change-Id: I7f5dec13b7ee36240a822ee52d430a7e27d8ca31 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/954050 Commit-Ready: Don Garrett <dgarrett@chromium.org> Tested-by: Don Garrett <dgarrett@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Jacob Kopczynski <jkop@chromium.org>

FROMGIT: drm/amd/display: disable CRTCs with NULL FB on their primary plane (V2) The below commit "drm/atomic: Try to preserve the crtc enabled state in drm_atomic_remove_fb, v2" introduces a slight behavioral change to rmfb. Instead of disabling a crtc when the primary plane is disabled, it now preserves it. This change leads to BUG hit while performing atomic commit on amd driver. As a fix this patch ensures that we disable the CRTC's with NULL FB by returning -EINVAL and hence triggering fall back to the old behavior and turning off the crtc in atomic_remove_fb(). V2: Added error check for plane_state and removed sanity check for crtc. Signed-off-by: Shirish S <shirish.s@amd.com> Signed-off-by: Pratik Vishwakarma <Pratik.Vishwakarma@amd.com> Reviewed-by: Harry Wentland <harry.wentland@amd.com> (cherry picked from commit 528664a326473ba23914f23f99af8ec99f1cfaaf git://people.freedesktop.org/~agd5f/linux branch:amd-staging-drm-next) BUG=b:73160971 TEST=stop & start ui login to guest mode atomictest -t all Change-Id: Iab79c801cc280e28562d9c15e85e64930c194dd0 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/950528 Commit-Ready: Shirish S <shirish.s@amd.com> Tested-by: Shirish S <shirish.s@amd.com> Reviewed-by: Dominik Behr <dbehr@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: devfreq: rk3399: fix accounting when rate change fails If we don't have enough time in vblank to set a new DDR frequency, we timeout and don't change the frequency. Since we do not want to return an error in this case to prevent log spam, we need to set the freq pointer to prevent the devfreq framework from incorrectly thinking we successfully went to the other frequency. BUG=b:74260504 TEST=Check that the rate for the dpll in /sys/kernel/debug/clk/clk_summary always matches /sys/class/devfreq/dmc/cur_freq Change-Id: Iee0c9043f6af01dfff02fed0ac68f573ffdf2299 Signed-off-by: Derek Basehore <dbasehore@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/952862 Reviewed-by: Sonny Rao <sonnyrao@chromium.org>
